blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: NGT lacks independent enforcement machinery and relies on government agencies for execution.
The tribunal faces a persistent shortage of expert members required for technical decision-making.
There is a growing volume of environmental disputes being brought before the tribunal.
A primary ongoing challenge is balancing economic development needs with environmental conservation.
Questions often highlight NGT's dependency on state and central government agencies for enforcing its orders.
Institutional limitations, such as the shortage of technical expert members, are frequently tested in policy-based questions.
Understanding the conflict between development and environmental conservation is crucial for main written examinations.
